findings.remediation: Review all WASM sources and imports; allow only integrity-verified modules with minimal host capabilities.
findings.impact: Unreviewed WebAssembly can execute opaque bytecode and exercise capabilities exposed through its host imports.
findings.attack_vector: A plugin compiles or instantiates a .wasm module whose provenance or imported capabilities may be unverified.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: decodes obfuscated payload and executes it in the same file
findings.remediation: Remove all decode-and-execute patterns; they are strongly correlated with malicious behavior.
findings.impact: Decoded payload executed in same file — classic obfuscation-to-RCE pattern.
findings.attack_vector: Buffer.from(base64).toString() → eval() chain; the base64 payload is invisible to static review.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: passes request-controlled input directly to a dynamic code evaluation API
findings.remediation: Remove dynamic evaluation and dispatch request values through a fixed allowlist of implementations.
findings.impact: Request-controlled dynamic evaluation can execute arbitrary code within the plugin process.
findings.attack_vector: A request body, query, parameter, header, argv, or input value reaches eval() or Function().
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: uses string concatenation or char-code construction to hide keywords (2 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Use readable, explicit code patterns; avoid character-code obfuscation.
findings.impact: Character-code construction hides string literals from grep-based detection.
findings.attack_vector: String.fromCharCode() builds dangerous strings at runtime — evades static patterns.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: contains 1 line(s) longer than 500 characters (possible minified/obfuscated code)
findings.remediation: Review extremely long lines; they may contain hidden logic.
findings.impact: Extremely long lines hide obfuscated or minified code from human review.
findings.attack_vector: Lines > 500 chars — code is structured to evade visual inspection.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Remove install-time side effects or document and review each lifecycle script.
findings.impact: Install-time lifecycle scripts run before the package is reviewed at runtime and inherit installer privileges.
findings.attack_vector: package.json declares preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare code that npm may execute during installation.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
